evidence.test_name: R1: loadConfig accepts plugin.repos and commit-pinned plugin.packages
R2: plugin repo help exposes git URL and local path repository management
R3: plugin help exposes install list enable disable update and sync commands
R4: update-all rejects newly unsafe package contents before copying runtime files
R5: resolveChain uses enabled plugin preset contributions and project-local overlays
R6: registry metadata validates DataSource static meta and bounded parent chains
R7: non-base official presets move out of core and into the official senti-presets artifact
R8: workflow command skill and config contributions live in the official workflow plugin artifact
R9: core dispatcher no longer hardcodes workflow and unavailable plugin commands fail non-zero
